title: Learned subgroup rules guide higher-component oxidation catalysts
summary: Rules learned from high-throughput catalyst measurements guided tests of more complex four- and five-component materials for propylene oxidation. Selected materials reached approximately 60% oxygenate yield in laboratory tests. The learned descriptor ranges are associative design guides, not proven atomic mechanisms or universal industrial performance rules.
organization: Fritz Haber Institute of the Max Planck Society; Humboldt University of Berlin; BASF; hte

evidence.tested: More complex catalyst compositions were tested against rules learned from three-component measurements.
evidence.unknown: Independent replication and industrial durability were not assessed; temperature rules did not transfer unchanged.
evidence.ai_role: Subgroup-discovery rule learning supported the stated study; experimental and interpretive work remained with researchers.

source_review.scope: Indexed primary publisher text and deposited publisher PDF abstract and selected experimental-validation Results; supplements not reviewed.
